# The preferred s-a-b-g path consumes one edge from each disjoint route.
# Sending one drone along s-c-b-g and the other along s-a-d-g takes 3 turns.
# Sequential priority planning instead sends both through a and b in 4.
nb_drones: 2
start_hub: s 0 0
end_hub: g 3 0
hub: a 1 0 [zone=priority]
hub: c 1 1
hub: b 2 0 [zone=priority]
hub: d 2 1
connection: s-a
connection: s-c
connection: a-b
connection: a-d
connection: c-b
connection: b-g
connection: d-g
